situation.en: A message from an unknown number says your account will close today. What do you do first?
situation.ur-Latn: Anjaan number se message aata hai ke aap ka account aaj band ho jayega. Aap pehle kya karengi?

label.ur-Latn: Ghar mein kisi se poochti hoon
Jo message kehta hai woh karti hoon

situation.en: A caller says they are from your bank and asks for the code that just came to your phone. What do you do?
situation.ur-Latn: Call karne wala kehta hai woh bank se hai aur phone par aaya code mangta hai. Aap kya karengi?

label.en: Say no and end the call
label.ur-Latn: Mana kar ke call band karti hoon

label.en: Give the code, since it is the bank
label.ur-Latn: Code de deti hoon, bank hai

situation.en: Do you know how to block a number that keeps sending you strange messages?
situation.ur-Latn: Kya aap ko pata hai ajeeb messages bhejne wale number ko block kaise karte hain?

label.en: Yes, I can do it myself
Someone would have to help me

situation.en: Imagine you shared a code by mistake and then got worried. What would you do first?
situation.ur-Latn: Farz karein aap ne ghalti se code de diya aur phir pareshan ho gayin. Aap pehle kya karengi?

label.en: Call the number on my bank card
label.ur-Latn: Bank card wale number par call karti hoon
Ghar mein kisi ko call karti hoon

situation.en: How do you feel about sending money from your phone?
situation.ur-Latn: Phone se paise bhejne ke baare mein aap kaisa mehsoos karti hain?

situation.en: How do you feel about starting a video call?
situation.ur-Latn: Video call shuru karne ke baare mein aap kaisa mehsoos karti hain?
